title: We Will Rock You

patterns.stomp: D D U - D D U -

notes: The guitar hardly plays in this song: it's all stomp, stomp, clap. So play the beat on guitar instead. Two down-strums on the low E5 for the stomps, then a sharp up-strum for the clap, then a rest. Try it in Listen mode, and get everyone else stomping along. Brian May's solo at the end is on Songsterr.
